after.name: Enemy Bleed Tick Damage
after.description: Damage of one tick of an enemy's bleed on you, every 0.5 s: 35 x the status tick skill curve (Bleed_Damage_Final, read on the enemy). Difficulty, role and enemy weapon damage don't scale it. That the enemy's skill curve equals the player's, at the same level and mode scaling, is an inference; the enemy's own level and group terms aren't established. The tick's own damage-resistance factor (BleedDamageResistanceModBonus) isn't modeled; no gear in the pack sets it (R114, R115).

changes.rationale: The nail gun's bleed tick on the player: 35 x the skill curve, unscaled by difficulty (R114, R115).

Target 5's nail gun bleeds the player for 2 s on every body hit, ticking every 0.5 s; hazard protection and the bleed resistance mod add into the status's resistance. Resistance shortening the duration, its 0.5 s floor and the first tick landing at application are inferences, the last matching the enemy-side rows (R114, R115).

before.name: Chemical Agent
before.description: Catalysis: Dealing and receiving status effects (Burn, Bleed, Shock, EMP/Disrupt, Poison and blind/disorient) builds stacks of Catalysis to a maximum of 12. Each stack grants: +2% Weapon Damage, +2% Status Effects. Each enemy within 25 Meters that is affected by a status effect grants +1 stack/sec. Being affected by status effects grants +2 stacks/sec. Stacks decay at 1 stack/sec after 5s if no enemies in the radius or you are affected by status effects. Reactant: At max stacks, killing a status-affected enemy grants bonuses for 5s: +25% bonus armor.

coverage.evidence: R35_PRIORITY2_REVIEW.md (talent-parameter comparison against the R32/R33 talent bundle); Reactant reload speed traced in the graph (CHEMICAL_AGENT_HANDOFF.md)

after.name: Chemical Agent

Each stack grants: +2% Weapon Damage, +2% Status Effects. Each enemy within 25 Meters that is affected by a status effect grants +1 stack/sec. Being affected by status effects grants +2 stacks/sec. Stacks decay at 1 stack/sec after 5s if no enemies in the radius or you are affected by status effects. coverage.evidence: R35_PRIORITY2_REVIEW.md (talent-parameter comparison against the R32/R33 talent bundle); Reactant reload speed traced in the graph (CHEMICAL_AGENT_HANDOFF.md); R115_SOURCE_REVIEW.md (R115): its graph reads both parts each second, 1 stack for each affected enemy within 25 m and 2 while the player is under a status. Fights gain 1 a second while the enemy being shot has any status; other affected enemies, and the player's own statuses, aren't counted yet: the player part would be a second rule on the same stacks, which fights don't take

changes.rationale: Chemical Agent's two source parts, and the one fights count (R115).
One 15 s timer from the first stack ends them all, and a kill in cover with this weapon restarts it (R112, R115).

before.name: Cover Shooter
before.description: Every bullet fired while in cover increases weapon damage by 1% up to 100%. The bonus lasts for 15 seconds. Getting a kill with this weapon while in cover resets the duration. The bonus damage is canceled by reloading, swapping weapons, or exiting combat.

coverage.evidence: R35_PRIORITY2_REVIEW.md (talent parameters); R112_SOURCE_REVIEW.md (R112): fights add a stack per bullet fired in cover, hit or miss, up to 100, and a completed reload or a swap clears them. Each stack lasts 15 s from its own shot. The source runs one 15 s timer from the first stack, which ends every stack together and which a kill in cover with this weapon restarts; fights model neither. The swap clear is inferred from the script's start, not shown.

after.name: Cover Shooter
after.description: Every bullet fired while in cover increases weapon damage by 1% up to 100%. The bonus lasts for 15 seconds. Getting a kill with this weapon while in cover resets the duration. The bonus damage is canceled by reloading, swapping weapons, or exiting combat.

coverage.evidence: R35_PRIORITY2_REVIEW.md (talent parameters); R112_SOURCE_REVIEW.md (R112, R115): fights add a stack per bullet fired in cover, hit or miss, up to 100. One 15 s timer, started by the first stack, ends them all, and a kill in cover with this weapon restarts it with the count kept, as in the source. A completed reload or a swap clears them; the swap clear is inferred from the script's start, not shown. Leaving combat also clears them in the source; fights are all in combat

changes.rationale: Cover Shooter's coverage with the source timer (R115).

before.name: Cover Shooter Stacks
before.description: Assumed currently retained Cover Shooter stacks (0–100), each adding 1% Weapon Damage. In a fight in cover (a cover cycle), fights count the stacks from bullets fired, and outside cover they hold 0; this value serves static comparisons. Fights hold each stack 15 s from its shot, where the source runs one timer from the first stack that a kill in cover restarts (R112).

after.name: Cover Shooter Stacks
after.description: Assumed currently retained Cover Shooter stacks (0–100), each adding 1% Weapon Damage. In a fight in cover (a cover cycle, or In cover set), fights count the stacks from bullets fired, under one 15 s timer from the first stack that a kill in cover restarts; in a fight out of cover they hold 0. This value serves static comparisons (R112, R115).

changes.rationale: The text names both ways a fight is in cover (R115).

exclusions: The bleed tick's damage resistance (BleedDamageResistanceModBonus): no stat; no gear in the pack sets it (R115).
What resistance shortens: duration is the likely reading, not shown (R114).
The first bleed tick at application: not in the data; matches the enemy-side rows (R115).
The enemy's own level and group terms in the bleed's skill curve: not established (R114).
Chemical Agent's other affected enemies within 25 m: not counted (R115).
Chemical Agent's +2 a second while the player is under a status: a second rule on catalysis_stacks, which fights refuse (trigger-key-conflict); needs an engine way (R115).
Bleed's slow and blocked regeneration on the player: no fight effect yet (R114).
